user.title: Connect to Ezlo Hub
user.description: Enter the hub's local IP address and your Vera/Ezlo cloud credentials. The integration will discover the hub serial, then fetch a local access token from the cloud.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the hub at that IP. Verify it is powered on and reachable from this network.
error.invalid_auth: Cloud authentication failed. Check your Vera/Ezlo username and password.
error.unknown: Unexpected error communicating with the hub.

abort.already_configured: This Ezlo hub is already configured.
